units.source_text: 尽管时间是短暂的，可我为什么竟热衷于这样荒唐的幻想呢？

en.t: Although the time was brief, why had I become so absorbed in such an absurd fantasy?

units.source_text: 冷静思考的话，我是想凭借这种无聊的愚蠢行动来触怒老师，

en.t: If I thought about it calmly, I had wanted to provoke the master through this pointless, foolish act,

units.source_text: 让他从继承住持的候选人名单中勾销我的名字，

en.t: to make him strike my name from the list of candidates to succeed him as abbot,

units.source_text: 从而我自己找出成为永远失去当金阁主人的希望的端绪。

en.t: and thereby to find for myself the first step toward losing forever the hope of becoming the master of the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 这时候，我甚至忘却了我对金阁长期以来的执著。

en.t: At that moment, I had even forgotten my long-standing attachment to the Golden Pavilion.
